info.cash_target: RBA cash rate target (%), one point per decision, dated when it took effect. Before 1990 there was no target.
info.cash_monthly: Monthly average (%): 3-month bank bills Jul 1969-Apr 1976, interbank overnight cash rate May 1976-Jul 1990, cash rate target from Aug 1990 (RBA table F1.1).
info.au_bond_5y: Australian Government 5-year bond yield (%), RBA tables F2, from Jan 1972: monthly average before 1995, end of month from 1995 (last daily value). Gap Jun-Aug 2013.
info.au_bond_10y: Australian Government 10-year bond yield (%), RBA tables F2, from Jul 1969: monthly average before 1995, end of month from 1995 (last daily value).
info.us_bond_10y: US 10-year Treasury yield (%): Shiller 1871-Mar 1953 and FRED GS10 1953-1961 (monthly averages), then end of month from FRED DGS10 (daily) from 1962.
